name: BrewPage API
description: Free instant hosting for HTML, Markdown, JSON, key-value stores, files and sites. Send ns=public to be found: gallery + Google, Bing & AI search. Omitted ns: private (MCP: a generated private namespace). Password or hidden: unlisted. A private link is not a lock: anyone with it can open it; add a password to restrict. Secrets allowed; likely ones are flagged in notices. For a secret: private namespace + password. Retain returned links. Give the user link and manageUrl; manageUrl is private (anyone who has it can edit or delete the publication): never post it publicly. Keep ownerToken; send it as X-Owner-Token on later publishes and updates; show it to the user on request. How BrewPage compares with GitHub Pages, GitHub Gist, Netlify Drop, Cloudflare Drop, Tiiny Host and Static.app: https://brewpage.app/compare. Agents: remote MCP at https://brewpage.app/mcp (no auth).
